title: Ethan Panorama
description: A custom panorama featuring Ethan's skin
body: '**Ethan Panorama**' is a lightweight resource pack designed to customize your Minecraft: Java Edition experience. It replaces the main menu background with a static panorama featuring a cool picture of Ethan's skin overlaid on a visually appealing and nicely designed background. It's compatible with Minecraft 1.21.x and offers a personalized touch for your game's start screen.
